jobs.occupation: Group Internal Auditor - Brussels - Financial Services
jobs.description:
Our client is an established international financial services group headquartered in Brussels. Operating in a regulated and international environment, the organisation combines financial expertise with a strong focus on governance, risk management and internal control.

To strengthen its Group Internal Audit department, we are currently looking for an experienced Group Internal Auditor.

Jobomschrijving

• Perform financial, operational and compliance audits across the Group
• Support the Group Chief Internal Auditor in defining and implementing the risk-based internal audit plan
• Independently manage complex audit assignments from scoping to final reporting
• Assess internal controls, governance and risk management frameworks, including IT/ICT-related risks
• Formulate clear and practical recommendations based on audit findings
• Present audit results to senior management and governance bodies
• Monitor the implementation of audit recommendations and action plans
• Coordinate audit follow-ups and contribute to the continuous improvement of the Internal Audit function

• Master's degree in Economics, Finance or another relevant field
• At least 7 years of relevant audit experience, ideally acquired within an international environment and/or a Big Four firm
• Strong knowledge of internal audit methodologies, risk-based auditing and internal control frameworks
• Previous exposure to IT/ICT audits is required
• Experience within Banking, Insurance or Financial Services is considered a strong asset
• A CIA, CISA or equivalent professional certification is considered an advantage
• Strong analytical capabilities with the ability to translate findings into practical and business-oriented recommendations
• Capable of managing complex audit assignments autonomously from start to finish
• Excellent stakeholder management skills and the ability to combine critical thinking with diplomacy and influence
• Proactive, structured and comfortable working independently within a compact audit team
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, combined with a good command of Dutch and/or French

Our client is a leading player in the packaging and industrial solutions sector, recognized for its innovation, operational excellence and commitment to sustainable manufacturing.

With a strong footprint across Europe and ambitious growth plans, the company is looking to strengthen its commercial presence within the DACH region (Germany, Austria & Switzerland) through the recruitment of a highly driven Business Development Manager.

This opportunity is ideally suited to a true sales developer, someone who enjoys identifying opportunities, opening new doors and driving market expansion rather than simply managing existing relationships.

Jobomschrijving

• Develop and execute a commercial growth strategy for the DACH region.
• Identify, prospect and convert new customers across targeted industrial sectors.
• Build and maintain a robust sales pipeline.
• Develop long-term relationships with key decision-makers.
• Understand customer needs and propose tailored technical solutions.
• Lead negotiations and successfully close commercial agreements.
• Collaborate closely with internal technical, operational and customer service teams.
• Represent the company at trade fairs, industry events and customer meetings.
• Monitor competitor activity and market trends.
• Maintain accurate forecasting and CRM reporting.

We are looking for a real business developper.

The successful candidate will demonstrate:

• Proven experience in Business Development, Technical Sales or B2B Commercial Development.
• A genuine passion for acquiring new customers and opening new markets.
• Strong prospecting, networking and relationship-building skills.
• An entrepreneurial mindset with a high degree of autonomy.
• Excellent communication and negotiation abilities.
• The resilience and determination required to develop business within a competitive market.

Experience within packaging, manufacturing, industrial products, paper, printing, labels, plastics or other technical environments is considered a strong advantage.

German is the key success factor for this role.

Given the strategic focus on the DACH region, candidates must possess:

• Perfect proficiency in German
• Professional French and/or English
• Additional languages are an asset

You must be capable of conducting negotiations, presentations and commercial discussions at senior decision-maker level entirely in German.

An organisation operating in the public sector.

Jobomschrijving

As an Accountant AZ your responsibilities are:

• Prepare and maintain accurate financial records and reports.
• Ensure compliance with accounting standards and public sector regulations.
• Manage accounts payable and receivable processes.
• Assist in the preparation of budgets and financial forecasts.
• Coordinate with external auditors and provide necessary documentation.
• Reconcile bank statements and monitor cash flow activities.
• Prepare and submit tax declarations and other regulatory filings.
• Provide financial insights and support decision-making processes.

A successful Bilingual Accountant should have:

• Proficiency in accounting principles and financial reporting.
• Strong knowledge of Winbooks.
• Fluency in English and French.
• Strong knowledge of public sector financial regulations.
• Residence in Brussels.
• Valid EU work permit.
• Experience at least 1 year in accounting.
• Attention to detail and excellent problem-solving skills.
• Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines efficiently.

Our client is a specialized consultancy company with a unique market position, having worked exclusively with the same international aviation industry leader for more than 15 years. This long-term partnership offers an exceptional combination of stability, expertise, and continuous technological evolution.

Operating within a highly international environment, the company supports business-critical data and analytics initiatives that enable strategic and operational decision-making across multiple regions and business functions. Thanks to its close relationship with its client, employees benefit from the scale, complexity, and career opportunities of a large multinational organization while enjoying the agility, accessibility, and human-sized culture of a smaller consultancy structure.

Jobomschrijving

As a Data Engineer / BI Consultant, you will contribute to the design, development, maintenance, and optimization of the organization's data ecosystem.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Developing, maintaining, and optimizing data pipelines within a Snowflake environment.
• Working with SQL and Linux/Bash to support data integration, automation, and transformation processes.
• Implementing and maintaining solutions within a modern Data Mesh architecture combining Data Lake and Data Warehouse principles.
• Ensuring the reliability, scalability, and performance of data flows and reporting solutions.
• Collaborating closely with international business stakeholders located across multiple countries and time zones.
• Gathering business requirements and translating them into sustainable and efficient data solutions.
• Supporting the continuous improvement of reporting, analytics, and Business Intelligence capabilities.
• Contributing to data quality, governance, and optimization initiatives.
• Participating in ongoing projects related to cloud data platforms and digital transformation.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with excellent communication skills and enjoys working in an international environment.

We are looking for someone who can demonstrate:

• 3 to 5 years of relevant experience in Data Engineering, Business Intelligence, Data Warehousing, or a similar domain.
• Hands-on experience with Snowflake at an intermediate level.
• Strong knowledge of:
• SQL
• Linux/Bash
• Data Factory
• Experience working with business stakeholders and translating functional requirements into technical solutions.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• The ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with international teams.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities.

The following skills would be considered an advantage:

• Experience with Data Mesh architectures.
• Knowledge of Power BI.
• Experience with Matillion.
• Experience with Teradata.

Languages:

• English is mandatory.
• French and/or Dutch are considered strong assets.

Are you ready for a challenging career in the FAB Engineering team? Would you like to work with the most high-tech devices? Then read on quickly!

As an Equipment Maintenance Engineer, you'll start your journey in the esteemed FAB Engineering team:

• You'll get hands-on experience with the high-tech process equipment in our cleanroom. No need to be an expert from day one – we'll give you the time to thoroughly understand these cutting-edge tools. The team takes pride in maintaining and fine-tuning some of the most advanced equipment globally. You'll even get a chance to work with first versions and prototypes, which is pretty exciting!

• You will work closely with equipment manufacturers and other process engineers, so you'll be collaborating with a diverse group of experts.

• You’ll be part of the FAB Engineering team that consists of over 100 talented individuals with whom you will form the beating heart of our research institute. Specializing in nano-electronics, your work will contribute to technological solutions in various fields like healthcare and energy.

• You hold a Master's degree in Industrial Science with a focus on Electromechanics or Mechanics, or you have acquired equivalent technical experience. If you're just starting out, that's perfectly fine! We welcome motivated beginners who are eager to launch their careers.

• You are genuinely passionate about technology and equipment, and you are not afraid to work hands-on. Your technical knowledge of pneumatics, pumps, motors, electronics, and (electro)mechanics is a valuable asset.

• We highly appreciate your collaborative spirit, while also trusting your ability to proactively plan and organize your work on your own.

• You have a very good knowledge of English.

You will work in a shift regime: early - late (6u-14u & 14u-22u) and 1 weekend every 3 weeks

As an Import & Export Coordinator at Lotus Bakeries, you play a key role in ensuring the seamless flow of goods across international markets. You coordinate import and export shipments, manage customs processes, and work closely with logistics partners, internal stakeholders, and customs authorities.
 

As part of the Import & Export team you will:
 
 

• Coordinate and manage international import and export shipments across multiple transport modes (ocean, road, air, and multimodal), ensuring timely delivery while optimizing logistics flows to balance service, cost, and operational requirements. 

• Prepare and submit import and export customs declarations in-house or in collaboration with customs brokers, ensuring accuracy and compliance with applicable regulations. Manage communication with local customs authorities and internal compliance teams to facilitate efficient customs clearance and the timely resolution of customs-related issues. 

• Monitor transport performance and proactively resolve issues such as delays, demurrage, detention, and other operational disruptions. 

• Maintain accurate shipping and customs documentation and follow up on discrepancies or corrective actions when needed. 

• Ensure accurate data entry and management across logistics and customs systems, including master data maintenance and customs decision tables in CAS, while safeguarding data quality, integrity, and compliance. 

• Act as the key operational contact for shipment-related questions and escalations and support the implementation of new logistics and customs processes. 
 

• You have a Bachelor or Master degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Transport, Customs, or a related field. 

• A (first) experience with international freight flows and customs formalities has given you a good understanding of ocean, road, and air transport. 

• With your strong organizational and communication skills in both Dutch & English, you are able to manage multiple priorities while maintaining an accurate and detail-oriented approach. 

• Working independently comes naturally to you, while you also enjoy collaborating with internal and external stakeholders to achieve shared goals. 

• A proactive, hands-on, and customer-focused mindset helps you adapt to changing priorities and remain effective under pressure. 

• You are comfortable working with Microsoft Office, and experience with SAP S/4 or customs systems is considered a plus. 

• Your genuine interest in international supply chain, trade, and customs motivates you to continuously learn and develop in this field.

You will be a member of our SEM/TEM team. This team is responsible for in-line and out-of-line released electron microscopy inspection.  As a TEM technician you ensure the smooth processing of the various TEM inspections, focusing on the quality of the inspection. 

As SEM/TEM technician you will have the following key responsibilities: 

• You follow-up the inline TEM queue.

• You adjust released recipes for automated TEM inspections.

• You are responsible for (semi)-automated and guided TEM inspections.

• You contribute to achieving targets.

• You help with statistical process control (SPC) on TEM tools. 

• Preferable you have a bachelor’s degree or associate degree (2-year program) in science (chemistry, biology, physics) or equal to experience.

• It would be a great plus if you have hands-on experience with automated metrology or SEM/TEM inspections in the semi-conductor industry.  

• You are a strong planner and you would enjoy working in a fast-paced environment. You certainly know how to multi-task and prioritize assignments.  

• You are a communicative team player with a very good knowledge of both English and Dutch.

• You are prepared to work in a shift system (early/late/night and 1 weekend out of 4).

Join a growing and international environment where you play a key role in maintaining a compliant document management process. As a Document Control Specialist, you will:

What will you do?

Coordinate, manage, and maintain critical documentation and administrative processes within the organization.

Ensure administrative activities are executed accurately and in compliance with internal procedures.

Support multiple teams by helping to coordinate tasks and ensure smooth day-to-day operations.

Assist during audits and maintain correct documentation, records, and archiving.

Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to optimize and streamline administrative workflows.

Act as a point of contact between departments to ensure clear communication and timely information flow.

You stay calm, focused, and structured, even when handling multiple tasks simultaneously.

You have a strong eye for detail and take full ownership of your responsibilities, always aiming for high-quality results.

You are comfortable working independently but also thrive in a collaborative team environment.

You adapt quickly to changing priorities and manage your workload efficiently without compromising accuracy.

Strong organizational and time-management skills are essential, as well as the ability to perform well in a fast-paced environment.

You are proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint).

You communicate fluently in spoken and written English.

Experience in a pharmaceutical or GMP-regulated environment is an asset, but not a requirement.

LVO Industries is a permanent capital holding company. We acquire family-owned and owner-operated businesses and partner with them to ensure their long-term success. At LVO, you’ll join a small, dynamic team operating in an entrepreneurial environment.
 

Role & Responsibilities :
As CTO, you are the digital control tower of the LVO group, responsible for the digital aspects of every portfolio company: Odoo, AI, software development and the Microsoft stack. You bring strong engineering and real AI expertise, set the standards, and make sure the right technology choices and practices are followed everywhere. The job is as much about coaching the teams as building IT solutions yourself in Odoo, AI and beyond. Your responsibilities will evolve over time, and will at least include:
 
 

• make sure all digital tools (Odoo, AI agents, the Microsoft stack, other third-party software) are well chosen and used to their full potential across teams. 

• ensure the IT teams are highly efficient and well-functioning, coaching them on engineering and AI best practices, code quality and testing. 

• drive the development of AI agents to accelerate automation, improve customer satisfaction and replace costly tools, building them yourself and enabling the POs and IT teams to build and run them. 

• implement, follow up and continuously optimize Odoo across the portfolio companies. 

• oversee the broader technical foundation: hosting, architecture, cybersecurity, testing and data. 

• help select external providers and partners, and make sure they deliver.  

Success means a digital strategy that performs across the group: strong automation, a better experience for staff and customers, solid cybersecurity, and technology that is future-proof and cost-effective.

Mindset :
More than anything else, we are looking for a candidate with a positive attitude, who is:
 
 

• a builder who codes and configures as naturally as they advise 

• a teacher at heart who leaves teams stronger than they found them 

• obsessed with using AI and automation to remove friction 

• comfortable carrying influence without a title to back it up 

• self-starting, pragmatic, allergic to needless process 

• at ease jumping between companies, stacks and roles 

• dependable: says what they'll do, then does it  

Requirements :
 
 

• a genuine developer and IT engineer background (degree in engineering, computer science or equivalent): you have built and shipped software yourself, stay hands-on with code, and are comfortable across the stack from application architecture to hosting, cybersecurity and automated testing 

• between 5 and 10 years implementing IT and automation projects, including ERP set-ups, in small and medium-sized businesses. 

• real depth in AI: hands-on experience designing and deploying AI-based solutions, and a clear view on applying AI best practices in a business context 

• able to be based in Brussels (Watermael-Boitsfort) and to travel within Belgium. 

• strong written and verbal communication skills in Dutch, French and English

Our client in the Netherlands, distributor in equipment, consumables and reagents for life sciences industry and universities, we are looking for a Sales manager (Brussels/Wallonia/ Luxemburg region) for a permanent position.
 

Verantwoordelijkheden
 
 

• After training of the products and equipment, you will be further guided by an experienced manager in the field to introduce the products to new and existing customers in the life science market. 

• You visit new customers and maintain contacts with existing customers.You listen to their needs, give advice and negotiate price proposals 

• You supervise and follow up demos of equipment / kits with customers in collaboration with the specialists. 

• You visit fairs, participate in seminars or webinars. 

• You meet your colleagues (1 day per month) at the office for team meetings, new product launches, administrative tasks, team building, etc 

• You report to the sales and marketing manager 

Vereisten
 
 

• You have a bachelor or master degree in biochemistry, biotechnology or you have relevant experience in a similar sales position. 

• You have a commercial attitude and you are communicative. 

• You have affinity with biotechnology lab equipment, consumables, reagents. 

• You can organize yourself, you are creative and can take initiative. 

• You speak and write fluently French and English and have a good knowledge of Dutch (is a plus).

You will be modelling a highly diverse set of treatment processes and plants for water industry
 

clients worldwide, with the goal of reducing greenhouse gas emissions, improving waterquality,
 

saving resources and making plants smart. By mastering and applying modelling techniques such
 

as bio/chemical kinetics, computational fluid dynamics (CFD) or the combination, you will unravel
 

what is happening inside water treatment systems and will be able to improve processes
 

significantly. After a while, you will be able to execute rather spectacular modelling work, for which
 

AM-Team is known. The complexity of the modelling projects will grow along with and will be
 

adjusted to your modelling knowledge and experience. You will also be developing a broad
 

knowledge on existing and novel industry processes.
 

The objectives of your modelling projects will be highly case dependent, but mostly you will make
 

clients happy by saving costs, saving energy, improving technology and competitive position,
 

accelerating technology development, and improving process performance and reliability.
 

Main responsibilities
 

• 
Project execution & delivery: Executing multiple modelling projects & delivery of the
 

project outcomes to the customers in the shape of reports and presentations. Typically,
 

projects execution involves. 2/3
 

Job offering – Solution Engineer
 

o Understanding project objectives & gathering relevant data
 

o Planning project milestones and executing projects in a stepwise & collaborative
 

manner.
 

o Organizing client meetings and preparing presentations & reports.
 

o Supporting other team members with expert knowledge.
 

• 
Technical communication & dissemination: Internal & external communication on
 

projects and at international events or in online webinars. Writing technical abstracts,
 

journal articles and social media technical blogs or posts.
 

• 
Research & development: Developing new modelling solutions tailored to market needs
 

in close collaboration with the team. Creating templates and SOPs for existing modelling
 

methods.
 

• 
Coaching & training: Continuous learning & improving through active trainings. Also
 

coaching others.
 

You will be guided by senior colleagues at the start and will gradually grow and do your work more
 

autonomously.

• Has at least 2-3 years of water or wastewater industry or relevant academic experience
 

related to working with modelling projects.
 

• Has at least MSc in (environmental/bioscience or relevant) engineering. Has strong
 

understanding and educational background of water treatment processes and/or
 

modelling of these processes. Knowledge and experience with CFD modelling is a plus.
 

• Deeply shares AM-Team’s core values.
 

o We value the fun factor: working with us makes you smile and makes us smile.
 

o Why should the sky be the limit? You are a person that is not afraid to think out of
 

the box and set ambitious goals.
 

o A team is so much more than a bunch of individuals: you are a true team player.
 

o We tailor to enhance value but fit for purpose: we stand for quality and the tailoring
 

of our approach to our team and customers.
 

o We have no boundary conditions: we have no geographical, cultural, or technical
 

boundaries.
 

o We never settle, and keep stirring, we want to infinitely learn and improve, both as
 

team and individuals
 

• Is interested in the wonder world of digitalisation and has passion for innovation.
 

• Is eager to learn and curious.
 

• Has ability to ask the right questions and carefully listen to clients to help them maximally
 

and truly understand their needs and problems.
 

• Has good (self) organisational skills and takes initiative.
 

• Has good presentation skills and can explain things simply, even when they are complex.
 

• Is fluent in English both written and orally - knowledge of another language is a plus (e.g.
 

Dutch, French, or German).

A technical role that makes models and digital twins deliver lasting value at the global scale
 

We’re looking for a water-passioned person that loves combining the water and wastewater
 

treatment side with data, models and digital twins. This role focuses on translating models and
 

data into real value for end customers at the global scale. Beyond the buzz. You will be working
 

in our technical team and will also be interacting regularly with our sales team.

• Has at least 3 years of water or wastewater industry or relevant academic experience related
 

to working with data, mechanistic modelling or hybrid modelling projects.
 

• Has an MSc in (environmental/bioscience or relevant) engineering. Has strong understanding of water treatment processes and associated modelling / data handling of those.
 

• Preferably has specific expertise in data science applications for (waste)water treatment
 

• Is willing to be working from our office in Ghent, Belgium
 

• Has good communication skills and can explain complex matter to customers
 

• Is fluent in English, both written and orally - knowledge of another language is a plus
 

• Shares our company values
 
 

• Transformative digital thought leadership: With the work we do, we don’t just create impact and improve things. We transform the water industry by providing cutting-edge digital solutions. 

• Innovation that solves: We dare to push boundaries and see innovation as a necessity in today’s world. However, dreaming is not enough. Practicality matters as well. Innovative thinking + practicality = impact 

• Together we are one team and pursue shared ambitions: A team is much more than a bunch of individuals. We believe we need people that are different in skills and similar in values to achieve big things

Our client, a biotech company based in Zwijnaarde, is bringing innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. With this treatment, they make a real difference every day in the lives of patients with cancer and other serious diseases.

The company is growing fast and is looking for motivated and dedicated team members.

Jobomschrijving

At Legend Biotech, as a Quality Control Support, you’ll have the chance to make a real difference.Your work will directly contribute to improving the lives of sick patients around the world.

Your responsibilities include:

•

• You live nearby Ghent and can easily commute to work, even without public transportation.

• You are flexible and able to work in shifts.

As a Global Mobility Specialist based in Wolvertem, Belgium, you will play a key role in building and further professionalising our Global Mobility Department. You will combine hands-on ownership of international mobility cases with the implementation of global mobility policies, stakeholder support and continuous process improvement. Working closely with HR teams and business stakeholders across the globe, you will help ensure compliant, efficient and employee-focused international assignments. This is a role for someone who enjoys combining operational excellence with strategic impact.

 Your job in a nutshell: 

• Manage international mobility cases including short- and long-term assignments, permanent transfers and international hires.
• Ensure compliance with immigration, tax, social security, payroll and labour law requirements across multiple countries.
• Act as the trusted point of contact for employees, HR teams and external partners on global mobility matters.
• Coordinate with specialist vendors and support internal and external mobility audits.
• Support the global rollout of mobility policies through training, guidance and practical tools.
• Build strong partnerships with HR, Payroll, Finance and Legal stakeholders worldwide.
• Drive process improvements, reporting, automation initiatives and data transparency through Excel and AI solutions.
• Reporting line: Global Mobility Manager. You will work closely with international HR and business teams across the Sarens organisation.
ABOUT YOU

You are a relationship builder who enjoys working across cultures and countries. You combine strong technical knowledge of international mobility with a hands-on mindset and the drive to make things happen. You communicate confidently with stakeholders at all levels, while maintaining exceptional attention to detail and compliance standards. Most importantly, you enjoy taking ownership and continuously looking for smarter ways of working.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Economics, Law, Human Resources or a related field.
• Minimum 5 years of experience in Global Mobility, international employment, immigration or a related discipline.
• Proven experience independently managing international mobility cases.
• Strong knowledge of immigration, personal income tax, social security, labour law and international payroll.
• Experience within consultancy, combined with in-house exposure, is considered a strong asset.
• Excellent communication skills in English and Dutch.
• Strong stakeholder management and intercultural communication skills.
• Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.
• Strong Excel and analytical skills.
• Interest in AI, automation and process optimisation.
YOU GIVE SOME, YOU GET SOME

At Sarens, we invest in people who help us rise to every challenge. In return for your dedication, expertise and ownership, we offer:

• A permanent full-time position (40 hours per week).
• Flexible working hours.
• 20 legal holidays, public holidays and 12 additional ADV days.
• Competitive salary aligned with your experience and seniority.
• Company car with fuel card.
• Mobile phone and subscription, Laptop, Meal vouchers.
• DKV hospitalisation insurance.
• Group insurance.
• Extensive training and development opportunities through our training centre, on-the-job learning and external programmes.
• Work location: Sarens Headquarters, 1861 Wolvertem, Belgium.
At Sarens, everyone is encouraged to Own Your Future. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates and are committed to equal opportunities for all.

The R&I Policy Officer will support CLERENS in their work for the Batteries European Partnership Association (BEPA). BEPA represents the battery innovation community in Brussels, representing both industry and research members. BEPA is the private partner in the Horizon Europe Batt4EU Partnership with the European Commission.

In close cooperation with the Secretary General and other BEPA team members, the consultant will help BEPA transition from the current Horizon Europe framework to the new R&I ecosystem that will come with the new EU budget. The R&I Policy Officer will bring strong technical expertise in batteries to support multiple BEPA Technical Working Groups and/or Task Forces. These working groups range in size from 50 to almost 200 battery experts and prepare the official inputs given by BEPA to the European Commission on the strategic direction of battery research within the Horizon Europe Programme and beyond.

Main Duties:

¿            You lead the operational management of BEPA Working Groups and Task Forces, working alongside chairs and co-chairs to ensure outputs are delivered on time. You own the agenda, drive discussions, present updates, and coordinate the dissemination of information.

¿            Support, together with the Secretary General and Executive Director, the monthly meetings of the Executive Board meetings, by preparing and following up on the strategic decisions taken;

¿            Contribute, in terms of content and organisation, to BEPA events, like the General Assembly and the Battery Innovation Days, and smaller events like technical workshops and matchmaking events;

¿            Actively engage with the BEPA members. Follow up on enquiries by current members, engage with prospective members by conducting proactive outreach activities and welcoming new members into the organisation;

¿            Support the BEPA Communication Officer by providing content for BEPA publications (e.g. newsletter, website, social media, etc.);
 
¿            University or advanced degree (doctorat) in battery or electrochemical engineering, electrochemistry, (battery) materials science, or a closely related technical field.

¿            In-depth technical knowledge of the battery sector: battery science, cell chemistry, materials, manufacturing, and system integration, combined with a solid understanding of the industry landscape, markets, value chains, and key players.

¿            Between 3-5 years of relevant experience in battery or energy-related R&I, whether in industry, a research institution, or a European association; experience with EU-funded innovation projects is an asset.

¿            Good knowledge of the workings of the European Union, in particular in the sphere of research and innovation (Horizon Europe); previous experience engaging with EU institutions or R&I policy is an asset.

¿            Ability to quickly grasp new topics and process information effectively, and to put thoughts into actions quickly.

¿            Ability to communicate effectively, both orally and in writing, with attention to detail.

¿            Capacity to collect, organise and analyse quantitative and qualitative data.

¿            Ability to plan and work independently, manage stress, multiple deadlines and effectively prioritise workload.

¿            Fluency in English is necessary; any additional European language is an asset.

¿            Proficiency in MS Office applications is a must; acquaintance with other software is a strong advantage.
 
¿            The opportunity to work for a great European initiative concretely supporting the clean energy transition.

¿            A challenging, multi-faceted role in a dynamic team with room to grow and take on additional responsibilities.

¿            A stimulating and dynamic international environment.

 

Applications

To apply, please send a motivation letter and CV in English to the HR Manager, Eftychia Michailidou at hr@clerens.eu with ¿BEPA - R&I Policy Officer¿ in the subject line.

 

Be aware that applications are reviewed continuously upon arrival; therefore, applying as soon as possible is advisable. Due to the expected high number of applications, only short-listed candidates will be contacted for interviews.

Your future job

As a production operator, you’ll provide support to the press operator during the production process. You’ll make sure that the glue goes into the correct glue tank and closely monitor the glue levels. In addition, you’ll welcome drivers and direct them to the right location.

You’ll also be responsible for maintenance tasks and cleaning the equipment, ensuring everything runs safely and smoothly.

In short: a varied role where you play an important part in keeping the production process efficient and well-organized!
